author: Marie Gilligan - Hospitality Business Consultant, open to work
text:
Work Smarter. Not Harder.

Simple AI-assisted systems for hospitality businesses.

Over the past few months, I've shared a range of ideas on LinkedIn about helping hospitality businesses become more efficient, more profitable and easier to manage.

We've talked about improving systems, streamlining operations, reducing unnecessary administration, strengthening recruitment and onboarding, creating better customer experiences, and finding practical ways to make businesses run more smoothly.

If there's one thing I've learnt over more than 20 years in hospitality, it's this - 
The businesses that consistently succeed aren't always the biggest.

They're the ones that are prepared to adapt, improve and look for better ways of doing things.

And now, day by day, we're entering another period of change, quicker than I thought was possible.

Artificial Intelligence isn't replacing hospitality. It never will.

People will always be at the heart of great hospitality.

What AI can do is remove many of the repetitive, time-consuming tasks that have traditionally kept managers and staff tied to paperwork instead of focusing on guests, growing the business and leading their teams.

Imagine...
✔ Recruiting and onboarding new employees in a fraction of the time.
✔ Producing professional documents in minutes instead of hours.
✔ Creating simple systems that reduce repetitive administration.
✔ Freeing up your staff to focus on customer service instead of paperwork.
✔ Improving consistency across your business without increasing payroll costs.

I completely understand that many business owners are still uncertain about AI, and that's perfectly understandable. New technology can feel overwhelming, especially when you're already busy running a business.

My role isn't to sell complicated AI software or expect you to become a technology expert.

My role is to help hospitality businesses identify practical opportunities where simple AI-assisted systems can save time, improve consistency and allow your team to focus on what really matters.

I've already seen how these systems can dramatically reduce the time spent on recruitment, documentation and administration, while maintaining a high professional standard.

The hospitality industry is changing rapidly, and businesses that are willing to embrace practical improvements will be better positioned to compete in the years ahead.  Sometimes, all it takes is a few small changes to make a significant difference.

If you could instantly make one task in your business faster, easier or more efficient, what would it be? Comment below - I enjoy hearing the challenges hospitality businesses are facing.

If you'd prefer a private conversation, I'd be delighted to help.

📧 marie@gilliganconsultancy.com or book a complimentary online chat at

🚀 From Site Security to Tech-Driven Site Safety: Transitioning my Career in Abu Dhabi! 🚀

For the past two years, I have been working with United Security Group (USG) on an active, high-risk Sewage Treatment Plant construction project in Ghantout, Abu Dhabi. Managing site access controls, perimeter patrols, and incident coordination near deep excavation zones has given me a deep, practical understanding of heavy infrastructure hazards and live plant environments.

However, my true passion lies in actively protecting lives and managing workplace risks systematically before incidents happen.

To turn this passion into a professional reality, I have spent the last few months heavily focused on professional safety training and modern digital data skills. I am proud to share that I have recently completed:

✅ NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC) — Curriculum & Examination completed (July 2026 — Results Pending).
✅ IOSH Managing Safely Certificate — Course & Examination completed (July 2026 — Results Pending).
✅ '1 Million Prompters' Initiative Certificate — Certified Prompt Engineer via Dubai Future Foundation & Dubai Centre for AI (DCAI), mastering advanced practical workflows and generative AI productivity systems.
✅ Critical Thinking in the Era of AI — HP LIFE Program, specializing in data evaluation strategies and ethical AI framework utilization.
✅ University of Helsinki AI Credentials — Successfully completed Elements of AI (100% exercise completion) and Building AI (87% final grade), focusing on algorithm data sorting and digital risk analytics.

By combining my fresh safety credentials with a strong Computer Science foundation, my goal is to add modern value to site operations. I look forward to leveraging advanced prompt engineering and data processing to optimize incident logging, streamline digital compliance reporting, and build highly effective toolbox talk structures.

Core Strengths & Credentials:

🔹Frameworks: Well-versed in Abu Dhabi OSHAD frameworks and TAQA Lifesaving Safety Rules.
🔹 Operations: Actively studying Permit to Work (PTW), WMS, Job Safety Analysis (JSA), and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols.
🔹 Emergency: Certified in Basic Firefighting and First Aid.
🔹 Languages: Fluent in English, Hindi, Nepali, and basic spoken Arabic.

I am actively seeking an entry-level opportunity as an HSE Assistant, Safety Watcher, or Junior Safety Officer in Abu Dhabi. I hold a valid UAE visa and am available to join immediately.
